intro.text: A large city of Mountaincrest on the River Violet, three days' journey upstream from Kingseat and the last town of middling size before the capital's suburbs begin.

description.text: Its name comes from being smaller than Kingseat and First Dukeseat. As it is still a large city, people have argued for decades over renaming it Smallerport. It has at least one theater.

items.text: On her way to Kingseat, December's boat, the Northern Eclipse, stopped at Smallport for an evening. Two sailors were set to guard it, but believing thieves would need another ship alongside, they played cards and checked the deck only every half hour. A brigand slipped aboard unheard and held a knife to December's throat.
She talked him out of robbing her, persuading him that she had far less money than his debts required and that hurting her would only make the city's officials hunt him harder. They never caught him.
